Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/20/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 598 as introduced adds an additional member to the Alabama Community College System Board of Trustees who has a background in either industrial training or human resources which will increase the meeting expenses of the Board, paid from the Education Trust Fund, by an estimated minimum of $610 annually.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy
